context.notes: Implementation matches all 11 ACs from financial-analysis-ticket-6.md. No feature creep. Scope is exactly FinBERT sentiment analysis on FusedRecord with per-article and aggregated results.

reliability.notes: All error paths handled: None input raises TypeError, empty articles return neutral result, blank articles skipped, missing title key defaults to empty string, network failure wrapped in ModelLoadError.
